title: Minimum rotations to a repeated string
prompt: Specification: Given a non-empty string s, return the smallest positive k such that rotating s left by k positions gives s again. For example, 'aaaa' needs 1 rotation and 'abc' needs 3. The function below is intended to satisfy this specification. Does it contain a bug? If yes, give the line number of the faulty statement (1-based, counting the `def` line as line 1). If the bug spans several lines, give the first line of the faulty statement. If there is no bug, set the line to null.

fields.line: integer|null (1-based, required when has_bug is true)

evidence.title: A test that exposes the defect

recommendation.text: I found a bug on line 7.

annotations.notes: Adapted from MBPP task_id 9. Returns the full length instead of the first matching rotation. Recommendation selected from offline Qwen3-8B samples; correctness is analysis-only. Recommendation selected from offline Qwen3-8B samples; correctness is analysis-only.
